svg.title: Uno R3 D11 PWM LED with Series Resistor

g.style: fill:#000000; fill-opacity:1.0000;stroke:#000000; stroke-opacity:1.0000; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;
fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;

g.text: For a red LED near 2 V with a 1 kohm resistor, the nominal current estimate is (5 V - 2 V) / 1000 ohm = 3 mA.

g.desc: For a red LED near 2 V with a 1 kohm resistor, the nominal current estimate is (5 V - 2 V) / 1000 ohm = 3 mA.

g.text: Check the actual LED and MCU limits. KiCad ERC and exact-net checks required; physical output is unverified.

g.desc: Check the actual LED and MCU limits. KiCad ERC and exact-net checks required; physical output is unverified.

g.text: Uno D11 is Timer2 output OC2A. The series path is D11 -> R1 -> LED anode; the LED cathode returns to GND.

g.desc: Uno D11 is Timer2 output OC2A. The series path is D11 -> R1 -> LED anode; the LED cathode returns to GND.

g.text: R1 is a separate current-limiting resistor for this LED. The onboard D13 LED is not connected to OC2A.

g.desc: R1 is a separate current-limiting resistor for this LED. The onboard D13 LED is not connected to OC2A.
